This PR registers two new elizaOS plugins from the `milady-ai` organization into the central plugin registry (`index.json`): `@elizaos/plugin-roles` (role-based access control with OWNER/ADMIN/MEMBER hierarchy) and `@elizaos/plugin-wechat` (WeChat connector via proxy API). This PR is safe to merge — it is a straightforward registry addition with correct ordering and verified source repositories. No logic, security, or structural concerns were found. No files require special attention.

topPRs.author: LamboPoewert
topPRs.body:
Adds the MadeOnSol plugin for Solana KOL trading intelligence and deployer analytics. **Package:** `@madeonsol/plugin-madeonsol` ([npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@madeonsol/plugin-madeonsol)) **Repository:** [github.com/LamboPoewert/plugin-madeonsol](https://github.com/LamboPoewert/plugin-madeonsol) **What it does:** - Real-time trade feed from 946 tracked Solana KOL wallets - KOL convergence signals (multi-KOL coordination detection) - KOL PnL leaderboard rankings - Pump.fun deployer alerts with KOL buy enrichment - Webhook management and WebSocket streaming tokens - Pays per request via x402 USDC micropayments on Solana **Actions:** `GET_KOL_FEED`, `GET_KOL_COORDINATION`, `GET_KOL_LEADERBOARD`, `GET_DEPLOYER_ALERTS` **Config:** `SVM_PRIVATE_KEY` (for x402 payments), optional `RAPIDAPI_KEY` (for webhooks/streaming) ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added support for the @madeonsol/plugin-madeonsol package mapping, enabling the application to recognize and resolve that plugin. This allows users to install and use the plugin more seamlessly without manual configuration.

Greptile Summary

This PR registers the `@madeonsol/plugin-madeonsol` plugin, which provides Solana KOL trading intelligence (trade feed, convergence signals, PnL leaderboard, deployer alerts) via x402 USDC micropayments. The change is a single-line addition to `index.json`, but the entry is placed after `@mascotai/plugin-connections` when it should precede it alphabetically.

Confidence Score: 5/5

Safe to merge; the only finding is a minor alphabetical ordering issue (P2). The change is a single registry entry addition. The sole issue — inserting the key one position out of alphabetical order — is a cosmetic P2 that does not affect functionality or correctness. index.json — entry should be moved one line earlier to restore alphabetical order.
